description: This Flutter widget defines a carousel component (OffersCarousel) that cycles through promotional banners using a PageView with automatic page switching via a Timer. It manages internal state to track the current banner, uses external banner style components, and displays dot indicators for navigation cues.

classes.name: OffersCarousel
classes.description: StatelessWidget serving as a container for the carousel component.

classes.name: _OffersCarouselState
classes.description: State class managing the internal state of OffersCarousel, including current page index, timer for auto-sliding, and building the carousel UI.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the PageController, sets up the Timer for automatic page switching, and calls super.initState().

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the PageController and cancels the Timer to clean up resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the carousel, including the PageView, dot indicators, and layout.
